newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday March 10.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro reiterates worries about Italy's labour market, calls blockage of 18 trillion lire already assigned to promote investments and create new jobs "sabotage". Scalfaro also warns new bicameral commission of need for independence of the legislative system (all).

* Prime minister Romano Prodi said labour market funds have been frozen because of a delay in the lower House of Parliament, the government itself is not to blame. Prodi also says he expects his majority coalition to last (all).

* The newly formed HPI (Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali) said it will merge with textiles group Marzotto to create one of the biggest textiles and clothing groups in the world. The new entity, to be called Gruppo Industriale Marzotto, will also own Italy's second largest publishing group Rizzoli Corriere della Sera (all). Marzotto intends a 3.61 billion lire capital increase as part of its operations to merge with HPI. The merger is widely seen to have been the handiwork of Enrico Cuccia, the grand old man of Italian finance (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
